refnamediv.refpurpose: Upsample a vector by interleaving given values or copies of the vector elements.

listitem.para: Scalar, vector, or matrix of real or complex numbers.
Scalar or vector of real or complex values. Specifies the values to be interleaved between the elements of `x`.
Boolean (`%t` or `%f`). If `%t`, `w` must be scalar, and each value in `x` is repeated `w` times. Default is `%f`.
Upsampled vector or matrix with interleaved values or repeated elements.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `upsamplefill` function upsamples a vector or matrix by interleaving specified values or repeating elements. If `cpy` is `%f`, the values in `w` are interleaved between the elements of `x`. If `cpy` is `%t`, each value in `x` is repeated `w` times.
